We got two candidate templates. Need to return mapped_rxn and template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash). The template_id likely is the reaction_id? The description says template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash). In search results, each entry has 'reaction_id' and 'template_hash'. Probably template_id is reaction_id. So we need to pick the appropriate template that matches our retrosynthetic step. The first template (reaction_id 214705) seems to be a sulfonamide formation from sulfonyl chloride? Let's examine retro_smarts_template: '[O;D1;H0:2]=[S;H0;D4;+0:1](=[O;D1;H0:3])(-[c:4])-[NH;D2;+0:5]-[c:6]>>O-[S;H0;D4;+0:1](=[O;D1;H0:2])(=[O;D1;H0:3])-[c:4].[NH2;D1;+0:5]-[c:6]'

This is forward? Actually retro template: product side left? It shows sulfonamide (O=S(NH-aryl)-aryl) -> sulfonyl chloride? Wait left side: O=S(NH-aryl)-aryl (sulfonamide) >> O-[S](=O)(=O)-aryl + NH2-aryl (aniline). That's exactly our retrosynthetic step: break N-S bond, form S-Cl? Actually product side shows O-[S](=O)(=O)-aryl (sulfonyl chloride?) but missing Cl. It shows O-[S](=O)(=O)-aryl (sulfonic acid?) Not exactly. But second template (reaction_id 723274) shows formation of sulfonamide from sulfonyl chloride (Cl-C(=O)-aryl) and thiol? Not correct.

Our target is sulfonamide with phenylsulfonyl chloride (Ar-SO2-Cl) reacting with aromatic amine. The template should break N-S bond and form S-Cl. The first template seems to break N-S and produce sulfonyl chloride? Actually product side: O-[S](=O)(=O)-c (sulfonyl chloride missing Cl). Might be sulfonic acid? Not perfect.

But we need to return mapped_rxn associated with the template that reproduces the reaction. Both have mapped_rxn. Which one matches our target? Our target has sulfonamide attached to aromatic ring (the sulfonyl part is attached to phenyl with F). The first template's product side includes O-[S](=O)(=O)-[c:4] (aryl sulfonyl chloride? missing Cl). Might be okay.

Second template's retro_smarts_template: Cl-C(=O)-aryl + NH-SH? That's not our case.

Thus choose first template (reaction_id 214705). Return its mapped_rxn and template_id = 214705.
